summary: claude-code reported NS-017 implemented (NOT verified): Cities point layer (v1.3.0): 284 OSM place nodes = Tunis (national capital, admin_centre of the country, capital=yes) + 23 other governorate capitals (admin_centre of each governorate relation) + 260 municipal seats (municipality admin_centre or same-name settlement node inside it). 56 of 338 OSM municipalities have no supporting node and get no point (listed in cities-report.json and docs/accuracy.md#cities); nothing invented. Each point: type, capital_of, ar/fr/en names, governorate/delegation/sector/municipality, lon/lat, x/y in the SVG frame. scripts/extract/cities.py; build writes dist/data/cities.csv|json, dist/svg/cities (full-low x 7 modes), point GeoJSON/TopoJSON per LOD; src types; test/cities.test.js; README section, roadmap ticked, docs. AC1 note: no population threshold, because OSM population tags are sparse; the selection rule is municipal-seat status.
